title: Senior Technical Product Manager
Website Product Manager - Growth
description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, https://www.trustpilot.com/review/qonto.com based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture https://qonto.com/en/careers/culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here https://medium.com/qonto-way/the-qonto-way-our-culture-is-our-strategy-90defd4895f9).
[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre https://www.linkedin.com/in/aprot/ and Steve https://www.linkedin.com/in/steveanavi/, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process https://medium.com/qonto-way/a-recruiters-dilemma-confronting-bias-in-hiring-b78acce148eb because the best teams are built on merit.
[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here https://medium.com/qonto-way/ai-at-qonto-vision-statement-725a7e2f659b) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
Join us as a Website Product Manager to own conversion strategy on qonto.com http://qonto.com, the primary acquisition engine for 600,000+ businesses across 8 European markets.
You will report to Sarah, our Lead Website PM. This is a hands-on product role inside a dedicated feature squad — you'll work daily with Growth Engineers and Designers, not just coordinate from a distance.
➡️ What you'll do
 - Own a section of qonto.com end-to-end: You'll be responsible for a defined part of the website — from identifying conversion problems to shipping the fixes. That means defining the strategy, running the sprints, and tracking the impact.
 - Run a continuous experimentation cycle: Set up and analyse A/B tests using tools like AB Tasty or VWO, draw conclusions from GA4 and Contentsquare data, and iterate fast. You'll be expected to have tests running at all times.
 - Align cross-functional stakeholders: You'll work weekly with SEO, Content, Product Marketing, Legal, and the French market. Getting alignment without authority is part of the job.
 - Promote Qonto's products on the website: Work with product teams to translate new features into compelling, conversion-optimised website experiences — landing pages, navigation flows, upsell surfaces.
 - Benchmark and bring new ideas: Regularly analyse competitor websites and best-in-class B2B SaaS sites to identify opportunities Qonto hasn't tried yet.
➡️ What we're looking for
 - 3-4 years of PM experience: You've shipped features end-to-end and can show the before/after on a metric. B2B SaaS or growth-focused product experience is a strong plus.
 - Hands-on with web analytics and CRO tools: You've used GA4, Contentsquare, Hotjar, or equivalent. You can pull your own data, spot patterns, and build a hypothesis without waiting for an analyst.
 - A/B testing methodology: You know how to size a test, define a success metric, and avoid common pitfalls (peeking, underpowered tests). You've run tests that failed and learned from them.
 - Clear communicator across functions: You can write a crisp brief for a designer, explain a prioritisation call to a sceptical stakeholder, and present results to a non-technical audience.
 - Working language: English and French fluency is required. Italian, Spanish, German or Dutch is a genuine plus given our 8-market scope.
➡️ What we can offer you
 - A website that is actually the product: At Qonto, qonto.com is not a marketing brochure — it's the #1 source of new customers. The PM who owns conversion has direct revenue impact, which means your work gets attention and resources.
 - A real feature team: You'll work in a squad with dedicated Growth Engineers and Designers — daily standups, weekly sprints, shared OKRs. You're not a lone PM throwing specs over a wall.
 - 8 markets, real complexity: The website serves France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal, and Austria — with different regulatory contexts, languages, and user behaviours. That's a genuine product challenge, not a copy-paste localisation exercise.
 - A test-and-learn culture with senior support: Bamby brings nearly 20 years of product and growth leadership. You'll get autonomy on execution and direct access to someone who has built products at scale — a combination that's harder to find than it sounds.
➡️ Your future manager
You’ll report to Sarah https://www.linkedin.com/in/sarahmahrach-rosado-digital, Lead Product Manager for our Website. Sarah joined Qonto in 2021 as a Senior Product Manager and stepped up as interim Head of Website in 2023. Before Qonto, she built digital products at Sodexo and BNP Paribas.
[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here https://qonto.com/en/careers/candidate-journey
[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice https://qonto.com/en/legal-documents/privacy-notice for full details.

title: AI Product Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Als AI Product & Project Manager (w/m/d) treibst du AI-Projekte in unseren Portfoliounternehmen und im Fund selbst voran - von der ersten Use-Case-Idee bis zur fertigen Umsetzung in Production. Du verbindest Produkt- und Userdenken mit technischer Nähe, baust selbst Prototypen und agierst an der Schnittstelle zwischen Tech-Teams, Portfolio-Stakeholdern und unserem Operating Partner AI.
 Deine Aufgaben 
 AI-Projekte vorantreiben: Du begleitest Use Cases von der Idee über die Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung - gemeinsam mit den Teams aus dem Portfolio und dem FLEX-AI-Team
 Produkt- und Userperspektive einbringen: Du stellst die richtigen Fragen, schärfst Anforderungen konsequent vom User her und sorgst dafür, dass aus technischen Möglichkeiten echte Produkte werden, die im Alltag und in Production funktionieren.
 Schnelle Prototypen selbst bauen: Mit Tools wie Cursor, Claude Code und etwas Python entwickelst du PoCs, die Portcos und wir im Fund als Ausgangspunkt für die Production-Umsetzung nutzen.
 An der Schnittstelle agieren: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem internen AI-Team zusammen und vermittelst zwischen technischer Umsetzung, Portfolio-Stakeholdern und Operating Partner - als Übersetzer, Treiber und Sparringspartner.
 Du arbeitest sehr eigenständig, priorisierst selbst und treibst Themen auch ohne enge Führung voran.
 Dein Profil 
 3-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in einer Mischung aus Produkt- oder Projektarbeit und technischer Nähe
 Erfahrung im Bauen von Prototypen: Python-Grundlagen, Umgang mit AI-Coding-Tools wie Cursor oder Claude Code, idealerweise erste Berührung mit APIs und LLM-Integrationen
 Solides Verständnis moderner AI-Stacks (LLMs, RAG, Agenten, Evals)
 Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
 Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (beides C1 - C2) in Wort und Schrift 
 Leidenschaft dafür, AI in unternehmerische Praxis zu übersetzen
 Was Dich erwartet 
 Gestaltungsfreiheit: Viel Raum für eigene Ideen - du entscheidest mit, welche Use Cases wir angehen und wie wir sie umsetzen
 State-of-the-Art Tooling: Arbeiten mit den neuesten AI-Tools und -Frameworks, ohne lange Freigabeschleifen
 Direkter Impact: Projekte mit spürbarem Effekt auf Business-Prozesse - in mehreren Industrien gleichzeitig
 Lernkurve & Verantwortung: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Operating Partner AI, Tech-Teams und C-Level-Leaders
 Benefits 
 Ein Umfeld, in dem dein Beitrag sichtbar ist und direkte Wirkung entfaltet - sowohl in den Portfoliounternehmen als auch bei FLEX
 Unternehmerische Verantwortung und schneller Lern- und Entwicklungspfad
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Gründern und C-Level-Leaders
 Moderne Arbeitsumgebung in Berlin mit flexibler Hybrid-Struktur
 Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung inkl. Bonus und unbefristeter Vertrag
 Regelmäßige Events, ein gemeinsamer Sommerurlaub sowie verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote wie beispielsweise Massage / Physiotherapie im Büro
 Über uns 
 FLEX Capital ist ein Private Equity Fonds, der sich auf Wachstums- und Buy-out-Möglichkeiten im deutschen Software- und Tech-Mittelstand fokussiert. Hinter FLEX Capital stehen sechs Seriengründer, die mehrfach marktführende Unternehmen mit internationaler Geschäftstätigkeit aufgebaut haben. Auf dieser Basis teilt das FLEX-Team seine Erfahrungen mit Unternehmern und Management Teams, unterstützt sie Hands-on und hilft ihnen so, die gemeinsamen Ziele zu erreichen.
 Kontakt 
 Join us! Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

title: IT Product Owner (w/m/d)
description:
Begleite KPMG bei den zukünftigen Herausforderungen unserer Kunden und Kundinnen. Begeistere auch Du Dich für die Vielfalt unserer Fragestellungen - und mach gemeinsam mit uns den Unterschied. Unterstütze gemeinsam mit Deinem Team aus dem Bereich Commercial Management die Geschäftsbereiche bei allen Fragestellungen rund um Preisstrategien, Angebotserstellung und in Verhandlungssituationen.
 Deine Aufgaben
 Gehst Du lösungsorientiert und motiviert jede neue Herausforderung an? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig. Bringe Dich ab dem 1. November 2026 hier ein:
 Produktstrategie: Du entwickelst Produktvisionen und Roadmaps für digitale Lösungen kontinuierlich weiter, priorisierst Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und Stakeholdern und stellst sicher, dass die Produktentwicklung einen nachhaltigen Beitrag zu den strategischen Zielen von KPMG leistet. 
 Lösungsdesign: Gemeinsam mit fachlichen und technischen Expert:innen erarbeitest Du skalierbare Lösungsansätze und bewertest diese hinsichtlich Machbarkeit, Benutzerfreundlichkeit, Datenverfügbarkeit, Performance sowie der Integration in bestehende Systemlandschaften. 
 Produktentwicklung: Von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung steuerst Du die fachliche Weiterentwicklung digitaler Produkte und sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen zielgerichtet und nutzerorientiert umgesetzt werden. 
 Digitale Transformation: Du schaffst mit digitalen Lösungen einen messbaren Mehrwert, vereinfachst Prozesse, erhöhst Transparenz und trägst dazu bei, die Effizienz sowie die Qualität der Leistungserbringung nachhaltig zu verbessern. 
 Innovation & Künstliche Intelligenz: Potenzielle Einsatzmöglichkeiten für Machine Learning, generative Künstliche Intelligenz und intelligente Assistenzfunktionen identifizierst Du frühzeitig, bewertest deren Nutzen und begleitest die Überführung geeigneter Anwendungsfälle in den produktiven Einsatz. 
 Einführung & Nutzerakzeptanz: Gemeinsam mit Change Management, Support und den Fachbereichen begleitest Du die Einführung neuer Funktionen, koordinierst Dokumentationen, Schulungsmaßnahmen und Feedbackprozesse und unterstützt eine erfolgreiche Etablierung neuer Arbeitsweisen. 
 Dein Profil
 Bildungshintergrund: Du verfügst über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, des IT-Managements, der Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
 Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, Requirements Engineering, in der Informationstechnologie-Beratung oder im Informationstechnologie-Projektmanagement zeichnet Dich aus.
 Produkt- und Technologiekenntnisse: Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung digitaler Produkte sowie Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Produktvision, Roadmap-Planung, Backlog-Management und Releaseplanung bringst Du ebenso mit wie ein breites Verständnis für technische Zusammenhänge, Systemintegrationen und moderne Anwendungslandschaften.
 Spezialkenntnisse: Du kannst digitale Produkte ganzheitlich von der ersten fachlichen Idee über Konzeption, Entwicklung und Test bis hin zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung im laufenden Betrieb begleiten; Kenntnisse im Umfeld von webbasierten Anwendungen, Datenplattformen, Schnittstellen oder Cloud-Architekturen sind dabei von Vorteil.
 Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden Dein Profil ab.
 Deine Benefits
 Willkommen im Team Damit Du von Beginn an voll bei uns durchstarten kannst, begleiten wir Dich mit strukturierten Onboarding-Maßnahmen während der gesamten Orientierungsphase. Zudem fördert Deine Führungskraft gezielt Deine fachliche und persönliche Integration ins Team.
 Vielfältige Karriereperspektiven Wir legen Wert auf die individuelle Entwicklung Deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Stärken: Deine eigenen Ambitionen reflektieren wir in strukturierten Entwicklungsgesprächen. Systematische und regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche unterstützen Dich beim Erreichen dieser Ziele. Ab dem Level Manager und Managerin kannst Du auch Personal- und Führungsverantwortung übernehmen. Deine Führungskompetenz fördern wir mit individuellem Coaching und spezifischen Führungstrainings. Als Teil des weltweiten KPMG-.Netzwerks bieten wir Dir zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten im In- und Ausland und somit wertvolle Einblicke in die Vielfalt unserer Tätigkeitsbereiche.
 Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben Wir sind überzeugt, dass es vor allem Vielfalt und Flexibilität braucht, um Innovationen zu fördern und langfristige Erfolge zu sichern. Nur so können wir die besten Ideen entwickeln und wirklich innovative Lösungen finden. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice-Option, Zeitkonten und Auszeiten schaffen wir Räume, um Privat- und Berufsleben miteinander zu vereinbaren. Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir Dich monatlich mit bis zu vier Stunden Freistellung für Dein soziales Engagement.
 Fort- & Weiterbildung Durch regelmäßige Trainings, Workshops und Weiterbildungen entwickelst Du Deine Fähigkeiten stetig weiter. Zudem fördern wir Berufsexamina sowie berufsbegleitende Master-Studiengänge. Mit unseren Rotationsprogrammen ermöglichen wir Deinen fachübergreifenden Einsatz. Diese Einblicke in die vielfältigen Aufgabenfelder bei KPMG erweitern Deinen Horizont und fördern Synergien in der Zusammenarbeit.
 Die abgebildeten Leistungen können je nach Position und Standort leicht variieren.

title: Product Owner Traffic Domain (m/f/d)
description:
Become part of our SWARCO team as
 Product Owner Traffic Domain (m/f/d)
 Company Description
 SWARCO is a growing international group with over 5000 employees on all continents.
This position is available in both Berlin, Germany, and Bucharest, Romania.
 Challenge
 Lead refinement sessions and sprint planning together with the development team
 Own and define requirements, epics, and user stories with a strong product mindset
 Manage and align with stakeholders across domains (e.g. sales, productmanagement, partners)
 Evaluate and structure incoming requirements, balancing business needs and product vision
 Set and continuously adjust team priorities in line with strategic goals
 Confidently handle mid-sprint changes while maintaining delivery stability
 Take ownership of release planning and communicate timelines transparently
 Provide clear and structured updates to senior management and stakeholders
 Highlight achievements, risks, and trade-offs to ensure transparency and informed decisions
 Collaborate closely with QA to define test scenarios and ensure customer sign-off
 Ensure high-quality, consistent, and understandable product documentation
 Actively incorporate user feedback into product decisions and roadmap planning
 Co-lead the team together with the Team Lead in a close and collaborative setup
 Profile
 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in a comparable role
 Knowledge in Traffic Domain or strong interest in mobility, traffic systems, smart cities, or similar environments
 A bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent
 Strong understanding of Agile principles and hands-on experience managing backlogs and sprints
 Product mindset: You take ownership beyond “just PO tasks” and avoid silo thinking
 Experience working in complex software environments (ideally cloud-based systems)
 Solid technical understanding and affinity (no deep engineering expertise required)
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across different levels and regions
 Ability to translate complex, regional requirements into clear and actionable product features
 Assertiveness and strong argumentation skills when prioritizing and making decisions
 Clear customer and user focus in all product decisions
 Proven team player with a collaborative and proactive mindset
 Experience with Jira and Confluence
 Fluent in English (written and spoken), German is a plus, other languages are appreciated
 Benefits
 A strong team spirit and strong cohesion - confirmed by the last employee survey. Teamwork takes centre stage with us
 SWARCO offers a secure job in a stable industry in an international group
 Benefit from customised training opportunities that promote your professional developmen
 Take advantage of 30 days' holiday and special leave, e.g. for marriage, for example
 Take advantage of our hybrid and flexible working arrangements, which enable both on-site and mobile working, depending on the job
 We offer a 15% contribution to the company pension scheme, far more than the statutory contribution, as well as capital-forming benefit
 Your health is important to us: benefit from (e-)bike leasing and a €160/year contribution to health care and fitness programmes, e.g. via wellhub
 Our offer for your personal well-being includes free, unbureaucratic external advice for professional, private or health-related issues
 #ITS
SWARCO is growing. Grow with us. The online application can be submitted with just a few clicks. We look forward to new talents who will help us shape the mobility of tomorrow.
 SWARCO Solution Center GmbH
 Storkower Straße 142
10407 Berlin
 Information on processing of your personal data is available https://www.swarco.com/privacy-information-applicants.

title: Product Owner (all genders)
description:
Product Owner (all genders) 
 Festanstellung, Vollzeit | Augsburg, Krumbach, Berlin, Ingolstadt, Erlangen, Leipzig, Münster, München, Karlsruhe
 XITASO ist ein gefragter Partner für anspruchsvolle Software- und Digitalisierungsprojekte in Branchen wie Anlagen- und Maschinenbau, Robotik, Medizintechnik sowie dem öffentlichen Sektor .
 Als Product Owner (all genders) gestaltest du digitale Lösungen von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden und interdisziplinären Teams aus Software Engineers, UI/UX-Expert*innen und Agile Coaches entwickelst du innovative Lösungen für komplexe Herausforderungen. 
 Was uns dabei besonders macht: Wir arbeiten in selbstorganisierten Teams , übernehmen Verantwortung und gestalten sowohl unsere Zusammenarbeit als auch die Zukunft von XITASO aktiv mit. Bei uns hast du den Freiraum, deine Ideen einzubringen und dich persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.
 Diese Aufgaben interessieren Dich: 
 Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden in einem interdisziplinären Team die Produktvision und Konzepte für individuelle Softwarelösungen und führst diese erfolgreich von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung.
 Du verantwortest das Anforderungsmanagement – von der Planung und Durchführung von Workshops über die Erstellung und Priorisierung von User Stories bis hin zur Pflege des Product Backlogs .
 Du übernimmst die Projektverantwortung und behältst Projektfortschritt, Ziele, Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Teamauslastung im Blick. 
 Du steuerst und begleitest das Team durch den agilen Entwicklungsprozess und gestaltest gemeinsam mit ihm Dailys, Reviews und Retrospektiven. Dabei werdet ihr von unseren Agile Coaches unterstützt.
 Du gestaltest XITASO aktiv mit und bringst Deine Erfahrungen, Ideen und Impulse auch über Dein Projekt hinaus in unsere Communities und die Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmens ein.
 Das zeichnet Dich aus: 
 Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Mathematik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Naturwissenschaften, Technik oder bringst durch deine bisherige Berufserfahrung nachweislich ein sehr gutes Verständnis für technische Zusammenhänge mit.
 Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle und kennst die Zusammenarbeit in agilen Softwareteams.
 Du kannst dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeiten und findest dich in sehr unterschiedlichen Kundendomänen zügig zurecht.
 Es fällt dir leicht, komplexe Zusammenhänge für die Zielgruppe passend darzustellen – verbal, schriftlich und visuell.
 Du bist neugierig auf neue Technologien und offen dafür, KI-gestützte Werkzeuge sinnvoll in deinen Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren. 
 Du bringst dein ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent gerne in Projekte ein.
 Du hast Freude an der Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikation mit Kunden und vertrittst klare Empfehlungen auch dann überzeugend, wenn unterschiedliche Interessen aufeinandertreffen. Dabei gelingt es Dir, verschiedene Perspektiven zusammenzubringen und alle Beteiligten auf dem gemeinsamen Weg mitzunehmen.
 Du schätzt die agile Arbeitsweise, bringst ein offenes Mindset mit und hast Freude daran, Verantwortung in einem selbstorganisierten Team zu übernehmen.
 Du besitzt sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1-Level) für eine klare und sichere Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Partnern.
 Das bieten wir Dir: 
 🌱 New Work & Kultur 
 Selbstorganisierte Teams mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum
 Verantwortung und Mitgestaltung
 Offene Fehler- und Feedbackkultur
 🤝 Mentoring & persönliche Entwicklung 
 Individuelles Mentoring ab dem ersten Tag
 Regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche („Catch-ups“)
 Führung auf Augenhöhe, basierend auf Vertrauen und Respekt
 📚 Lebenslanges Lernen 
 Fachliche und überfachliche Trainings
 Interne TechTalks, externe Fortbildungen und Konferenzen
 💻 High-End Software Engineering 
 Anspruchsvolle, innovative und vielseitige Projekte
 Cross-funktionale Teams mit modernen Technologien
 Gelebte Expertenkultur und teamübergreifender Wissensaustausch
 👨 👩 👧 Familienfreundlichkeit 
 Zuschuss zu Betreuungskosten bis zu 250 €/Kind
 Lohnfortzahlung für Kinderkrankentage
 💬 Gemeinschaft & Events 
 Regelmäßige Events (z. B. Retreats, Sommerfeste)
 Persönliche Begegnungen & Teamzusammenhalt
 Ab Tag 1 Teil der vielfältig vernetzten Community
 🕓 Arbeitszeit & Flexibilität 
 Freie Wahl von Arbeitszeit und -ort
 Flexible Arbeitszeitkonten, 30 Tage Urlaub, Teilzeitoption, Sabbatical & Workation
 💚 Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden 
 Mental Health Taskforce
 JobRad & weitere Angebote
 🌍 Vielfalt & Inklusion 
 Diversity Taskforce für Perspektivenvielfalt
 Kultur der Zugehörigkeit: Jede*r soll sich angenommen fühlen
 Gehaltsinformationen: 
 Innerhalb unseres einheitlichen und transparenten Gehaltsframeworks ordnet sich das Bruttojahresgehalt der Position bei einer Spanne von 64.000 – 86.000 EUR ein und orientiert sich an verschiedenen Faktoren, wie Qualifikation und Erfahrung.
 Lerne uns und unsere Arbeitsweise besser kennen: 
 https://xitaso.com/karriere/

title: Entrepeneur in Residence/Product Lead
description:
Are you a builder who thrives in ambiguity, gets energy from talking to real users, and wants to turn emerging agentic AI capabilities into a product people actually rely on?
 About JetBrains
 We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.
 What You’ll Do
 NoPressure is an early-stage startup within JetBrains' Innovation Hub. We started by using AI-powered simulations to help people practice high-stakes workplace conversations. Now, we're exploring how agentic AI and real-world context can provide personalized, moment-of-need practice and support at work.
We’re looking for an Entrepreneur in Residence / Product Lead to partner with our technical founder. This is a 0→1 role where you’ll define our vision and venture strategy. You’ll figure out who our ideal customer is, identify high-value use cases, and validate key hypotheses through rapid experimentation. Working alongside a small, fast-moving engineering team, you will shape both the product and how it gets to market, turning early signals into something organizations want to adopt.
 Day To Day, You Will
 Define the product and venture strategy, identifying key uncertainties and deciding what to test and build first.
 Conduct continuous customer discovery to understand real workplace workflows, pain points, and behaviors.
 Pinpoint the most compelling ideal customer profile (ICP) and initial use cases for growth.
 Design and run lightweight experiments, prototypes, and agentic experiences to test hypotheses before committing full engineering resources.
 Establish clear metrics and evaluate commercial and behavioral evidence to decide whether to iterate, double down, or pivot.
 Shape positioning, messaging, and early acquisition or sales motions to bring the product to initial customers.
 Monitor market shifts, emerging agent architectures, and competitor developments to uncover new opportunities.
 Collaborate closely with the technical founder and engineering team to move quickly from ideas to shipped prototypes.
 What You’ll Bring
 A builder mindset that favors quick prototypes and direct learning over waiting for perfect requirements.
 Deep curiosity about how people build new skills and navigate challenging interactions at work.
 Comfort operating with high autonomy, speed, and decision-making under uncertainty.
 Strong discovery skills that separate genuine demand and observed behavior from polite validation.
 Clear, direct communication skills for pitching to and working with senior decision-makers.
 Strong collaboration habits when partnering closely with engineering teams on AI-native products.
 What You’ll Need
 A Track record of taking products or ventures from initial ambiguity to launch and early market adoption.
 Hands-on experience building, launching, or experimenting with AI/agentic products or emerging technologies.
 Demonstrated experience in early customer acquisition, founder-led sales, positioning, or commercialization.
 Experience in L&D, coaching, sales enablement, HR tech, or behavior-change products.
 The technical fluency required to evaluate agentic workflows and work directly alongside software engineers.
 End-to-end ownership experience across strategy, discovery, product development, and go-to-market strategy.
 What Success Looks Like
 In this role, success means rapidly turning market ambiguity into actionable direction. You will establish a validated ideal customer profile and high-value use cases through real user evidence rather than assumptions. You’ll build an experimental cadence that uncovers genuine demand early, helping the team ship an agentic AI experience that users regularly rely on and organizations actively invest in.
 Why join JetBrains?
 Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
 Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
 Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
 Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
 Relocation support – Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
 Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
 Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
 Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.
 We are an equal opportunity employer. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.
If this sounds like the kind of challenge you’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you.

title: PLM360-Program Manager (f/m/d)
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 
 Join a transformation that is shaping the future of product lifecycle management across Gas Services. You will lead the integrated PLM360@GS program framework, bringing together solution design, migration, business and digital workstreams, S4E integration, templates, pilots and rollouts into one aligned and transparent program. Working across teams, you will turn complex dependencies, risks and priorities into clear actions, enabling reliable delivery of Siemens Energy’s strategic PLM platform. Every day, you will connect business and technology perspectives, create organizational alignment, and help drive part-centric, data-driven lifecycle management across engineering, manufacturing and service.
 How You’ll Make An Impact
 Lead the execution of the PLM360@GS strategy, coordinating solution design, migration, business and digital workstreams, S4E integration, templates, pilots and rollout activities while actively managing dependencies across the program landscape.
 Own and maintain the integrated program plan, consolidating milestones, project management gates, releases, migration activities, critical paths and cross-program dependencies to ensure delivery transparency and readiness.
 Facilitate alignment across stakeholders, priorities, resources and timelines, partnering with project managers, workstream leads, providers and governance bodies to resolve conflicts and drive informed decision-making.
 Run program governance and reporting, preparing executive decision forums, managing risks and escalations, overseeing change control, and maintaining a single source of truth for program status, actions, decisions and responsibilities.
 Oversee integration and migration assurance, collaborating with relevant teams to govern PLM-to-S4 interfaces, testing, releases, cutover, handover and operational readiness while ensuring successful rollout
 What You Bring
 Degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration or a comparable field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
 Proven experience managing complex end-to-end IT or digital programs with multiple workstreams, governance structures and diverse stakeholder groups.
 Strong knowledge of product lifecycle management processes and enterprise PLM implementations, including hands-on experience with Teamcenter projects; experience integrating PLM environments with SAP or S/4 is a strong advantage.
 Expertise in integrated planning, dependency management, risk and issue management, change control, governance and executive-level reporting, with the ability to translate complexity into clear decisions and accountability.
 Excellent communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills in an international, cross-functional environment. You have fluent English skills, and German language skills are an advantage.
 About The Team
 Our Gas Services team offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
 Who is Siemens Energy? 
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
 Our Commitment to Diversity
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
 Rewards/Benefits
 In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
 We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
 We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
 The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
 In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 
 We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

title: Senior Outside Counsel Program Manager
description:
As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.
 Job Description
 We are on the lookout for a Senior Outside Counsel Program Manager to join the Legal Operations Team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.
Join the team that protects and enables Delivery Hero's growth. In the Legal Team, you'll support key initiatives by providing proactive legal guidance that aligns business goals with regulatory standards. Your work will help mitigate risks and ensure we're positioned for sustainable, long-term success—making you a key contributor to our mission of delivering amazing experiences worldwide.
You will build and run the way Delivery Hero instructs, steers and pays external law firms across 65 countries and a legal department with in-house lawyers. This is a greenfield programme. The Outside Counsel Guidelines, the firm panel and the management platform are being created now, and you will own them. You will report into Global Legal Operations and partner with our Procurement department on the purchasing-relevant steps.
Your tasks include:
 Design and run matter intake and scoping, so that every engagement has a defined boundary, an owner and a budget before a firm is instructed. 
 Own the outside counsel budget end to end, from forecasting and accruals through variance analysis to reporting for legal leadership and Finance. 
 Build and govern the firm panel, draft and enforce the Outside Counsel and Billing Guidelines, and work with Procurement on the annual rate review. 
 Design alternative fee arrangements, and make matters specifiable and comparable enough to be priced on a fixed-fee basis. 
 Act as business owner of the outside counsel management program, leading rollout, adoption, and integration with our ERP and source-to-pay landscape. 
 Run performance scorecards and business reviews with panel firms, resolve billing disputes, and partner with Procurement and Finance on major negotiations, supplier onboarding, third-party risk and enterprise savings reporting. 
 Qualifications
 5+ years in outside counsel management, legal operations, or law firm finance or business development, ideally including time in a corporate legal department or a legal operations consultancy. 
 Demonstrated expertise across panel governance, rate negotiation, RFP and RFI management, alternative fee structuring and billing guideline enforcement. 
 Deep knowledge of the legal market: law firm delivery models and economics, and the effect of AI on how legal services are delivered and priced. 
 Hands-on experience with outside counsel management or e-billing platforms, and strong analytical skills in budgeting, benchmarking and modelling. 
 A track record of building programmes from scratch in complex, multi-jurisdictional organisations, and of leading change with stakeholders who cannot be managed by instruction. 
 Credibility with General Counsel, law firm partners, procurement and finance teams. Fluency in English is required, German is an advantage. 
 Additional Information
 Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.
 Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
 We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
 We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses. 
 Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym. 
 Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
 The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers. 
 Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together 10 things you should know about moving to Berlin and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub and check out more information about moving to Berlin. 
 Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers created in collaboration with our recruiters. 
 Ready to join our team? If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!
We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.
We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.

title: Senior Project Manager Energy Permitting
description:
Shape a future with purpose at Arup in Germany
 Supporting the delivery of renewable energy and grid infrastructure projects
 Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 75 years, guiding how we shape a better world.
As the global energy transition accelerates, Arup is strengthening its capabilities to support the development and delivery of renewable energy and energy infrastructure projects. Our work focuses on enabling the integration of clean energy systems and supporting the regulatory and technical processes required to bring critical infrastructure projects forward.
Permitting plays a key role in unlocking the development of renewable energy plants and grid infrastructure. Navigating complex regulatory frameworks and coordinating multidisciplinary teams are essential to ensuring projects move efficiently from early development to construction readiness.
In this role, you will contribute to the successful planning and approval of renewable energy and energy infrastructure projects, including substations, underground and overhead cables, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and hybrid energy systems. Working closely with developers, authorities, engineering teams and environmental specialists, you will support the permitting process and help accelerate the delivery of projects that are critical to the energy transition.
 The Opportunity
 As a Project Manager for Energy Infrastructure with a focus on German permitting, you will support the planning and approval of renewable energy plants and grid-related infrastructure, including substations, underground and overhead cables, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), and hybrid energy systems.
You will contribute to navigating Germany’s permitting landscape (including BImSchG, EnWG, NABEG and BauGB) and support the coordination of approval processes required for the development of energy infrastructure projects. Working closely with authorities, developers, TSOs/DSOs, engineering teams and environmental specialists, you will help ensure that projects progress efficiently through the permitting phases.
This role provides the opportunity to work on complex energy transition projects while further developing expertise in regulatory processes, project coordination and multidisciplinary collaboration.
 As a PM Permitting Energy At Arup, You Will
 Permitting & Regulatory Support
 Support the coordination of permitting activities for renewable energy plants and grid infrastructure projects in Germany. 
 Assist in the preparation and review of permit documentation, including technical studies, environmental assessments and application packages. 
 Contribute to approval processes under regulatory frameworks such as BauGB, BImSchG, EnWG and NABEG. 
 Liaise with permitting authorities, municipalities, environmental agencies, TSOs/DSOs and other relevant stakeholders as part of the project team. 
 Track permitting requirements, approval milestones and documentation to ensure compliance with German and EU regulatory standards. 
 Support the identification of potential permitting risks and contribute to mitigation strategies. 
 Project Management & Coordination
 Support the planning and coordination of renewable energy and grid infrastructure projects from early development through permitting phases. 
 Monitor project schedules, deliverables and key milestones in collaboration with internal teams and external partners. 
 Coordinate inputs from multidisciplinary teams including engineering, environmental, geotechnical and grid connection specialists. 
 Assist in risk identification and support the implementation of mitigation measures. 
 Prepare internal and external reporting and contribute to project governance processes. 
 Stakeholder Engagement
 Participate in meetings and workshops with authorities, clients and project stakeholders. 
 Support communication and documentation for consultation and public participation processes. 
 Assist in preparing technical materials and presentations for project meetings and regulatory submissions. 
 Commercial & Project Development Support
 Support tender preparation, feasibility assessments and early-stage project development activities. 
 Assist in coordinating inputs for proposals and bid submissions. 
 Maintain documentation and tracking of permitting obligations, constraints and key project requirements. 
 Does this role inspire you?
 We Are Looking For Someone Proactive And Dynamic Who Is Willing To Be Part Of The Energy Team In Arup Germany. Ideally, You’ll Bring
 University degree (Master or equivalent) in Engineering, Environmental Planning, Infrastructure Planning, Energy Systems or a related discipline. 
 7-10 years of professional experience in project coordination, permitting or development of renewable energy or energy infrastructure projects. 
 Experience supporting permitting processes for renewable energy, grid infrastructure, substations, cables or similar projects is highly desirable. 
 Familiarity with German regulatory frameworks such as BImSchG, BauGB, EnWG or NABEG is an advantage. 
 Good understanding of German and EU permitting frameworks related to energy infrastructure. 
 Strong organisational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple project tasks simultaneously. 
 Effective communication and stakeholder engagement skills. 
 Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary and international project teams. 
 Structured, analytical and solution-oriented working approach. 
 Fluent German (C1) and strong English skills. 
 Conditions
 Immediate incorporation
 How to apply for this vacancy?
 To apply for this vacancy, register your updated CV and a cover letter in English.
